decision: Stop native-complement, unprojected-hybrid and native-only branch; no second bank or learning-rate/projection/carry variants.
reason: Both hybrid operators lose to the strong bilateral reference in each order. Complement and unprojected hybrid have near-identical order-averaged effects. Improvement over native-only does not demonstrate superiority to the strong coefficient merger.
scope: One exposed development expert bank and two correlated orders; no universal impossibility conclusion.
next: Test paired block gradient selection for calibration against same-pool random selection.
